mapper.select: SELECT BB.BOOKSET_ID FROM BOK_BOOKSET BB left join BOK_BOOKSET_DATE BBD on BBD.BOOKSET_ID = BB.BOOKSET_ID WHERE BB.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND BBD.BOOKSET_DATE > to_date(#{seitleDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
SELECT * FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T WHERE T.P_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT tradeId,--交易编号 booksetId,--产品代码 booksetName,--产品名称 vDate,--缴税/退税开始日 mDate,--缴税/退税结束日 seitleDate,--缴税/退税日期 interestIncome,--利息收入 dividendIncome,--红利收入 difbetIncome,--价差收入 SUM(interestIncome+dividendIncome+difbetIncome) appreciationTax, --增值税 constructionTax,-- 城建税附加 educationTax,-- 教育税附加 placeeducationTax,-- 地方教育费附加 SUM(constructionTax+educationTax+placeeducationTax) additionalTax, --增值税附加 taxidenType, --缴税/退税 acctsubjectType, standardCcy FROM (SELECT TPD.TRADE_ID tradeId, BB.BOOKSET_ID booksetId , --产品代码 BB.BOOKSET_NAME booksetName ,--产品名称 to_char(TPD.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, --缴税/退税开始日 to_char(TPD.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, --缴税/退税结束日 to_char(TPD.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') seitleDate, --缴税/退税日期 NVL( (SELECT TFD.FEE_AMT FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TFD WHERE TFD.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID AND TFD.FEE_TYPE = 'TAX0102' ),0) interestIncome, --利息收入 (SELECT TFD.FEE_AMT FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TFD WHERE TFD.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID AND TFD.FEE_TYPE = 'TAX0202' )dividendIncome, --红利收入 (SELECT TFD.FEE_AMT FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TFD WHERE TFD.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID AND TFD.FEE_TYPE = 'TAX0302' )difbetIncome, --价差收入 (SELECT TFD.FEE_AMT FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TFD WHERE TFD.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID AND TFD.FEE_TYPE = 'ALT0102' ) constructionTax,-- 城建税附加 (SELECT TFD.FEE_AMT FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TFD WHERE TFD.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID AND TFD.FEE_TYPE = 'ALT0202' ) educationTax,-- 教育税附加 (SELECT TFD.FEE_AMT FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL TFD WHERE TFD.TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID AND TFD.FEE_TYPE ='ALT0302' )placeeducationTax,-- 地方教育费附加 TPD.PS taxidenType, --缴税/退税 BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE acctsubjectType, BB.STANDARD_CCY standardCcy FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING BDA ON TPD.TRADE_ID = BDA.BUSI_NO AND TPD.BUSI_TYPE = '16' JOIN BOK_BOOKSET BB ON BB.BOOKSET_ID = BDA.BOOKSET_ID WHERE TPD.TRADE_ID=#{tradeId} ) GROUP BY tradeId, booksetId, booksetName, vDate, mDate, seitleDate, interestIncome, dividendIncome, difbetIncome, constructionTax, educationTax, placeeducationTax, taxidenType, acctsubjectType, standardCcy
